verdict_reasons: Reward of 0.0 correctly reflects that the agent's output failed the SSIM gate (mean_ssim=0.7016 vs gate=0.70, but gated cubic scaling yields 0.0 because the margin is negligible)
Agent used a genuinely algorithmic approach (physics simulation with wall bouncing and AABB collision resolution) with a small set of hand-tuned velocity constants
No anti-cheat gates were triggered - the source passed all checks (regex scan, dump literal gate, flat array gate, string literal gate, non-nice float gate)
The agent's physics model diverges from the reference quickly due to imprecise initial velocity estimates and a missing 3-phase wall-shrinking mechanic that the reference uses
The scorer's SSIM gate at 0.70 with cubic exponent means the agent needed mean_ssim significantly above 0.70 to score non-zero, and 0.7016 yields essentially 0.0 after cubic scaling
outcome_detail: Agent produced a rendering 12-square bouncing simulation that passed anti-cheat and duration checks, but mean SSIM of 0.7016 barely crossed the 0.70 gate threshold, yielding 0.0 after cubic gating. The core issue is that the agent's physics model lacks the reference's 3-phase wall-shrinking mechanic and uses approximate initial velocities.
strategy: Extract frames, detect colors, estimate velocities, build physics sim in Revideo
agent_behavior: Extracted reference frames at 4fps and 24fps using ffmpeg, then visually inspected key frames at different timestamps
Wrote Python scripts to detect colored square centers by RGB thresholding across all 433 frames, tracking trajectories per color
Estimated initial velocities using 5-frame baseline averaging and iteratively refined them through multiple render-compare cycles
Built a correct wall-bounce and AABB collision resolution physics simulation in TypeScript/Revideo
Struggled with Revideo's frame-stepping API, trying waitFor(1/FPS), yield, and useTime approaches before settling on precomputed states with useTime
Ran ~5 render-compare iterations, achieving mean per-square error of ~154px but could not improve further
Did not identify or implement the 3-phase wall-shrinking mechanic (walls contract and partially recover over time), which is the defining feature of the reference animation
Completed work in ~46 minutes of agent execution time out of 2-hour budget
